reviewContext: President-authorized integration of structural irreducibility, procedural structure compression, law-plus-residual representation, deterministic fleet partitioning and on-demand logical-world materialization into the existing kernel governance and procedural storage architecture without creating a new runtime component or touching live Supabase
reviewedSemantics: the kernel now distinguishes Structural Irreducibility from Causal Irreducibility: a large graph, address map, work schedule or logical world may be procedural-derived when every required element is exactly reconstructable from a smaller generator contract
the canonical structural representation is GENERATOR_LAW + PARAMETERS + DOMAIN_BOUNDARIES + RESIDUAL_EXCEPTIONS + VERIFICATION_PROOF rather than a claim that every explicit relation can be discarded
a modular mapping such as (k*x+b) mod N is only one candidate operator family and receives no priority from visual or mathematical elegance

candidate uses include derived graph edges, deterministic addressing/sharding, fleet work partitioning, reproducible traversal/search order, structural signatures/prefilters and on-demand world materialization
procedural fleet work generation must prove required coverage, non-overlap or explicitly declared overlap, collision behavior and exact replay before replacing explicit assignments
custom procedural indexing/addressing must be benchmarked against mature hashing, indexing, compression and partitioning baselines before adoption
logical world size may exceed canonical stored size only by materializing deterministic derived structure on demand; this is explicitly not physical RAM or compute creation

the required benchmark compares EXPLICIT STRUCTURE vs conventional compression/mature index or partition baseline vs PROCEDURAL GENERATOR + RESIDUAL EXCEPTIONS using canonical bytes, writes, residual ratio, exactness, reconstruction/query cost, branch cost, materialization amplification and collision/coverage behavior
Mission Gate now hard-blocks destructive removal of explicit structure without exact reconstruction proof

Mission Gate now requires review for unknown generator reconstruction or unknown coverage/collision semantics and emits optimization guidance for explicit reproducible structures, full fleet assignment lists, custom procedural indexes without baseline comparison and unnecessary persistence of materialized worlds
Mission Gate self-test expands from 8 to 11 cases to cover unproven structural deletion, unknown generator coverage and a verified-generator optimization candidate
